description: Read a documentation page as markdown, or one section of it. Give a page slug ("indexing"), a /docs path, a jsonpad.io URL (with or without .md, and with an optional #anchor), "sdk/jsonpad-sdk", "sdk/jsonpad-realtime-sdk", "cli/reference" or "cli/readme". Long pages are cut at a section boundary; read on with the returned nextSection.

maxChars.description: The most characters of markdown to return

page.description: The page: a slug, path or URL

section.description: A heading anchor ("filtering-items") or heading text; overrides a #anchor in page

name: read_doc
title: Read a JSONPad docs page
